history.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Clean bold clear 2D cartoon sprite production sheet, true transparent background. Crisp continuous dark outlines, solid flat clean colors and at most ONE broad smooth cel shadow per surface. Every material follows same finish including leaves, fur, feathers, wood and stone. No painted/engraved/embossed/pebbled/daubed material, grain, gradients, crosshatching, dots as texture, furry edges or photoreal detail. No text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, logos, religion, religious clothes/buildings, national/religious/political flags. Preserve all important silhouettes completely with generous alpha margins and gutters; no ground shadow or backdrop. WIDE3:1 canvas with exactly ONE ROW of THREE distinct separate COMPLETE whole-body growth stages of ONE SPECIES. LEFT Baby, CENTER Young, RIGHT Grand, growing progressively in maturity and size within equal cells. A friendly mint/lime-green snail with two eyestalks, peach underside and a round orange-brown SPIRAL shell, three broad green fern leaves sprouting above shell. Baby small round shell; Young longer larger shell; Grand largest with fuller broad fern leaves. Same smooth spiral shell/face in all three. All three stages must preserve face, species body plan, colors and signature markings as the same growing friend. All face slightly right, kind appealing expressions. Keep complete ears/antennae/horns/wings/legs/tails inside own third, generous12percent margins, no overlap or bodyparts crossing into other cells. No external props except the described parts; alpha background. No labels or dividers.
